blocks.text: the + birlik ot: butun tur haqida

75-darsda umumiy ma'noning asosiy yo'lini ko'rdik: ko'plik, artiklsiz — **Giraffes** are tall. Ingliz tilida yana bir, rasmiyroq yo'l bor: **the + birlik ot** butun turni, butun bir toifani bildiradi — **The giraffe** is the tallest animal. Bu yerda gap aniq bir jirafa haqida emas: «jirafa» degan **tur** xuddi bitta narsa kabi ko'riladi. Bu shakl ilmiy matnlarda, ensiklopediyada, yangiliklarda, ma'ruzalarda ko'p uchraydi. O'zbekchada ham shunday deymiz: «**Jirafa** — eng baland hayvon» (birlikda). Farqi shuki, inglizchada oldida **the** turishi shart.

rows: eng ko'p, so'zlashuvda — deyarli har doim mumkin (→ 75-dars)
ilmiy, ensiklopedik uslub; tur yaxlit holda
**A giraffe** can run at 60 km an hour.
«A tiger is in danger» → **The tiger** / **Tigers** are in danger.

blocks.text: Hayvon, o'simlik, ixtiro, a'zo, pul birligi

**the + birlik** asosan **tasnif** qilinadigan narsalar bilan ishlaydi: hayvon va o'simlik turlari (**the** wolf, **the** cotton plant), ixtiro, mashina va asboblar (**the** telephone, **the** wheel, **the** printing press), musiqa asboblari (**the** piano — 73-dars), inson a'zolari umumiy ma'noda (**the** heart, **the** brain), pul birliklari (**the** som, **the** pound). Har qanday ot bilan esa bunday qilinmaydi: «**The** book is important» yoki «**The** teacher works hard» umumiy ma'noda g'alati eshitiladi — bunday hollarda ko'plik ishlatiladi: **Books** are important.

items.text: **The wolf** was once common in these hills.
items.translation: Bir paytlar bu tepaliklarda **bo'ri** ko'p uchrardi.

items.text: **The brain** needs a lot of energy.

blocks.text: Yoqtirish haqida gapirganda **the + birlik** ishlatilmaydi: I like **cats** — mushuklarni yaxshi ko'raman (umuman). I like **the cat** — (o'sha) mushuk menga yoqadi (aniq bittasi). Ya'ni like, love, hate, be afraid of dan keyin umumiy ma'noda doim ko'plik: She's afraid of **dogs**.
the + sifat: the rich, the elderly, the unemployed

Ba'zi sifatlar **the** bilan birga jamiyatdagi **odamlar guruhini** bildiradi: **the rich** — boylar, **the poor** — kambag'allar, **the elderly** — keksalar, **the unemployed** — ishsizlar. O'zbekchada sifat ot bo'lib, `-lar` oladi («boy» → «boylar»), inglizchada esa so'z **sifatligicha qoladi**: `-s` qo'shilmaydi («the poors» emas), lekin fe'l **ko'plikda**: The rich **are** getting richer. Bitta odam haqida bu shakl ishlatilmaydi — sifatdan keyin ot kerak: **a** rich **man**, **an** unemployed **person**.

rows: a rich man, a poor family
a young woman, an elderly man
a sick child, an injured driver
an unemployed engineer, a homeless person
a disabled athlete, a blind musician

items.text: **The poor** suffer most when prices rise.
We should do more for **the elderly**.

blocks.text: the + millat: the French, the Swiss — lekin Uzbeks

Millat nomlari ikki xil ishlaydi. `-sh`, `-ch`, `-ss`, `-ese` bilan tugaydigan nomlar (British, English, French, Dutch, Irish, Welsh, Spanish, Swiss, Chinese, Japanese) aslida **sifat** — shuning uchun butun xalq haqida **the + sifat**, `-s` siz, ko'plik fe'li bilan: **The French are** proud of their cuisine. Bitta odam — **a Frenchman / a French woman**, **an Englishman**, **a Dutchman**, **a Spaniard** yoki shunchaki sifat: He's **French**. Qolgan ko'pchilik millat nomlari esa **ot** — ular odatdagidek `-s` oladi: **Uzbeks**, **Germans**, **Americans**, **Kazakhs**; bitta odam — **an Uzbek**, **a German**. Bunday nomlarda butun xalq haqida **the** ixtiyoriy: (**The**) **Uzbeks** are famous for their hospitality. Til nomi esa doim artiklsiz: **English** is easy to start but hard to master.

rows: the British, the English, the French, the Dutch
a British woman, an Englishman, a Frenchman, a Dutchman
the Chinese, the Japanese, the Swiss
a Chinese man, a Japanese woman, a Swiss
an Uzbek, a German, an American, a Kazakh
a Turk, a Pole, a Swede, a Scot

items.text: **The Swiss** are famous for their watches.
**Uzbeks** and **Tajiks** share a lot of traditions.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I like the cats» (umuman) → **I like cats**; «A tiger is in danger of extinction» → **The tiger is** / **Tigers are** in danger; «the poors», «the unemployeds» → **the poor**, **the unemployed** (`-s` yo'q); «The rich is ...» → **The rich are** ...; «He is a poor» → **He's a poor man**; «The French is ...» → **The French are** ...; «She is a French» → **She's French** / **a French woman**; «the Uzbek are» → **the Uzbeks are**; «The English is difficult» (til) → **English is difficult**.

O'zbekcha `-lar` ga qarang: «boylar, keksalar, ishsizlar» → **the rich, the elderly, the unemployed** (`-s` siz, chunki bu sifat). «fransuzlar, gollandlar, yaponlar» → **the French, the Dutch, the Japanese** (`-s` siz). «o'zbeklar, nemislar, amerikaliklar» → **Uzbeks, Germans, Americans** (`-s` bilan, chunki bu ot). Qoida: millat nomi `-sh / -ch / -ss / -ese` bilan tugasa — `-s` qo'shilmaydi.

Bog'liq darslar: umumiy ma'nodagi ko'plik (Children love games) — 75-dars; ta'rifdagi a / an (A cardiologist is a doctor who ...) — 71-dars; play the piano — 73-dars; davlat nomlari (the USA, the Netherlands) — 77-dars.

rows: I like **cats**. (the cat — aniq bir mushuk)

examples.title: Species: **the giraffe**, **the snow leopard**
examples.description: the + birlik ot — butun hayvon yoki o'simlik turi haqida, ko'pincha ilmiy, ensiklopedik uslubda: The giraffe is the tallest animal.

sentences.text: **The giraffe** sleeps for less than two hours a day.
sentences.translation: **Jirafa** kuniga ikki soatdan kam uxlaydi.

sentences.text: You can find **the snow leopard** only high in the mountains of Central Asia.
sentences.translation: **Qor qoploni** faqat Markaziy Osiyo tog'larining baland qismlarida uchraydi.

sentences.text: In the past, **the tiger** lived in the river valleys of Uzbekistan.
sentences.translation: Ilgari O'zbekistonning daryo vodiylarida **yo'lbars** yashagan.

sentences.text: **The camel** can survive for weeks without water, which makes it perfect for desert travel.
sentences.translation: **Tuya** suvsiz haftalab yashay oladi, shuning uchun cho'lda yurish uchun juda qulay.

sentences.text: Scientists are trying to save **the saiga antelope** from extinction.
sentences.translation: Olimlar **sayg'oqni** yo'qolib ketishdan saqlab qolishga harakat qilishyapti.

sentences.text: Farmers depend on **the honeybee** to pollinate their fruit trees.
sentences.translation: Fermerlar meva daraxtlarini changlatishda **asalariga** tayanadi.

sentences.text: Which animal is faster, **the cheetah** or **the horse**?
sentences.translation: Qaysi hayvon tezroq: **gepard**mi yoki **ot**mi?

sentences.text: In a dry country, **the cotton plant** is a problem because it needs so much water.
sentences.translation: Quruq mamlakatda **g'o'za** muammo tug'diradi, chunki u juda ko'p suv talab qiladi.

sentences.text: Is **the dolphin** really as intelligent as people say?
sentences.translation: **Delfin** rostdan ham odamlar aytganchalik aqllimi?

sentences.text: Because of hunting and climate change, **the polar bear** may disappear within this century.
sentences.translation: Ovchilik va iqlim o'zgarishi tufayli **oq ayiq** shu asrda yo'qolib ketishi mumkin.

examples.title: Inventions, organs, money: **the wheel**, **the heart**
examples.description: the + birlik ot — ixtiro, mashina va asboblar turi (the telephone, the printing press), inson a'zolari umumiy ma'noda (the heart, the brain) va pul birligi (the som, the pound).

sentences.text: Do you know who invented **the telephone** and in which year?
sentences.translation: **Telefonni** kim va qaysi yilda ixtiro qilganini bilasizmi?

sentences.text: **The printing press** made books much cheaper and changed European history.
sentences.translation: **Kitob bosish dastgohi** kitoblarni ancha arzonlashtirdi va Yevropa tarixini o'zgartirdi.

sentences.text: These days **the smartphone** has replaced the camera, the map and the alarm clock.
sentences.translation: Hozir **smartfon** fotoapparat, xarita va budilnik o'rnini egalladi.

sentences.text: **The heart** pumps about seven thousand litres of blood a day.
sentences.translation: **Yurak** kuniga taxminan yetti ming litr qon haydaydi.

sentences.text: Sleep is essential because **the brain** uses the night to store memories.
sentences.translation: Uyqu juda muhim, chunki **miya** tunda xotiralarni saqlaydi.

sentences.text: Uzbekistan's currency is **the som**, and Kazakhstan uses **the tenge**.
sentences.translation: O'zbekiston valyutasi — **so'm**, Qozog'iston esa **tenge** ishlatadi.

sentences.text: Alcohol and fatty food can seriously damage **the liver**.
sentences.translation: Spirtli ichimlik va yog'li ovqat **jigarga** jiddiy zarar yetkazishi mumkin.

sentences.text: Many historians say that **the wheel** was the most important invention ever.
sentences.translation: Ko'p tarixchilar **g'ildirakni** eng muhim ixtiro deb hisoblaydi.

sentences.text: For short journeys, **the bicycle** is still the cheapest and cleanest way to get around a city.
sentences.translation: Qisqa masofalar uchun **velosiped** hali ham shaharda yurishning eng arzon va toza usuli.

sentences.text: Since **the pound** fell against the dollar, holidays abroad have become more expensive for British families.
sentences.translation: **Funt** dollarga nisbatan arzonlagandan beri britaniyalik oilalar uchun chet eldagi ta'til qimmatlashdi.

examples.title: Three ways: **Owls** / **The owl** / **An owl**
examples.description: Umumlashtirishning uch yo'li: ko'plik (so'zlashuvda eng ko'p), the + birlik (ilmiy, tur sifatida), a + birlik (har qanday bittasi). Yoqtirish va tur yo'qolishi haqida a ishlatilmaydi.

sentences.text: **Owls** hunt at night, so you rarely see them during the day.
sentences.translation: **Boyqushlar** kechasi ov qiladi, shuning uchun ularni kunduzi kamdan-kam ko'rasiz.

sentences.text: **The owl** has been a symbol of wisdom since ancient times.
sentences.translation: Qadimdan **boyqush** donolik ramzi hisoblanadi.

sentences.text: **An owl** can turn its head almost all the way round.
sentences.translation: **Boyqush** boshini deyarli to'liq aylantira oladi.

sentences.text: I love **horses** — I've been riding since I was ten.
sentences.translation: **Otlarni** yaxshi ko'raman — o'n yoshimdan beri ot minaman.

sentences.text: Do you like **the horse** in the photo? It's Jasur's.
sentences.translation: Suratdagi **ot** yoqdimi? U Jasurniki.

sentences.text: **Tigers** and **leopards** are both in danger of extinction.
sentences.translation: **Yo'lbarslar** ham, **qoplonlar** ham yo'qolib ketish xavfi ostida.

sentences.text: **The Turan tiger** died out in the twentieth century.
sentences.translation: **Turon yo'lbarsi** yigirmanchi asrda qirilib ketgan.

sentences.text: **A dog** needs daily exercise, so think carefully before you get one.
sentences.translation: **It** har kuni harakatlanishi kerak, shuning uchun it olishdan oldin yaxshilab o'ylang.

sentences.text: My niece wants to know whether **the shark** is a fish or a mammal.
sentences.translation: Jiyanim **akula** baliqmi yoki sutemizuvchimi, bilmoqchi.

sentences.text: **Computers** are everywhere now, but **the computer** was once a machine that filled a whole room.
sentences.translation: Hozir **kompyuterlar** hamma joyda, lekin bir paytlar **kompyuter** butun xonani egallaydigan mashina edi.

examples.title: **the rich**, **the poor**, **the elderly**
examples.description: the + sifat — jamiyatdagi odamlar guruhi: the rich, the poor, the young, the old / the elderly, the sick. Ko'plik fe'li bilan, `-s` siz.

sentences.text: **The rich** are getting richer, while prices keep rising for everyone else.
sentences.translation: **Boylar** yanada boyib bormoqda, qolganlar uchun esa narxlar oshishda davom etmoqda.

sentences.text: The new law should help **the poor** pay for their medicine.
sentences.translation: Yangi qonun **kambag'allarga** dori-darmon uchun pul to'lashda yordam berishi kerak.

sentences.text: In Uzbek culture, **the elderly** are treated with great respect.
sentences.translation: O'zbek madaniyatida **keksalarga** katta hurmat bilan munosabatda bo'linadi.

sentences.text: **The young** often don't understand why their grandparents worry so much.
sentences.translation: **Yoshlar** ko'pincha bobo-buvilari nega bunchalik xavotirlanishini tushunmaydi.

sentences.text: Volunteers deliver hot meals to **the sick** and **the old** in our neighbourhood.
sentences.translation: Ko'ngillilar mahallamizdagi **bemorlar** va **qariyalarga** issiq ovqat yetkazib berishadi.

sentences.text: Should **the rich** pay higher taxes? — I think so, but not everyone agrees.
sentences.translation: **Boylar** ko'proq soliq to'lashi kerakmi? — Menimcha, ha, lekin hamma ham rozi emas.

sentences.text: My grandmother isn't **rich**, but she always gives money to **the poor** during Ramadan.
sentences.translation: Buvim **boy** emas, lekin Ramazonda doim **kambag'allarga** pul beradi.

sentences.text: Is enough being done to help **the elderly** who live alone?
sentences.translation: Yolg'iz yashaydigan **keksalarga** yordam berish uchun yetarlicha ish qilinyaptimi?

sentences.text: Nilufar works for a charity that provides free lawyers for **the poor**.
sentences.translation: Nilufar **kambag'allarga** bepul advokat beradigan xayriya tashkilotida ishlaydi.

sentences.text: **An elderly man** sat next to me on the bus, and we talked about how life for **the old** has changed.
sentences.translation: Avtobusda yonimga **bir keksa kishi** o'tirdi va biz **qariyalar** hayoti qanday o'zgargani haqida gaplashdik.

examples.title: **the unemployed**, **the homeless**, **the injured**
examples.description: the + sifat yoki sifatdosh: the unemployed, the homeless, the injured, the disabled, the blind, the deaf. Bitta odam haqida — sifat + ot: an unemployed man, a homeless woman.

sentences.text: The government has promised new training courses for **the unemployed**.
sentences.translation: Hukumat **ishsizlar** uchun yangi o'quv kurslari va'da qildi.

sentences.text: **The injured** were taken to hospital in Samarkand by helicopter.
sentences.translation: **Yaradorlar** vertolyotda Samarqanddagi kasalxonaga olib ketildi.

sentences.text: In winter the city opens extra shelters for **the homeless**.
sentences.translation: Qishda shahar **uysizlar** uchun qo'shimcha boshpanalar ochadi.

sentences.text: Many stations in London still aren't accessible to **the disabled**.
sentences.translation: Londondagi ko'p bekatlar hali ham **nogironlar** uchun moslashtirilmagan.

sentences.text: Modern phones have special settings for **the blind** and **the deaf**.
sentences.translation: Zamonaviy telefonlarda **ko'zi ojizlar** va **karlar** uchun maxsus sozlamalar bor.

sentences.text: Bekzod has been **unemployed** since March, so he's taking an IT course.
sentences.translation: Bekzod martdan beri **ishsiz**, shuning uchun IT kursida o'qiyapti.

sentences.text: **A homeless man** was sleeping outside the station when we arrived.
sentences.translation: Biz yetib kelganimizda vokzal tashqarisida **bir uysiz odam** uxlab yotgan edi.

sentences.text: Two of **the injured** are still in a serious condition, doctors say.
sentences.translation: Shifokorlarning aytishicha, **yaradorlardan** ikkitasining ahvoli hali ham og'ir.

sentences.text: Our company doesn't just talk about helping **the disabled** — it actually hires **disabled people**.
sentences.translation: Kompaniyamiz **nogironlarga** yordam haqida gapirib qolmaydi — haqiqatan ham **nogironligi bor odamlarni** ishga oladi.

sentences.text: When the factory closed, **the unemployed** in our town had to look for work in Russia or Kazakhstan.
sentences.translation: Zavod yopilgach, shaharchamizdagi **ishsizlar** Rossiya yoki Qozog'istondan ish izlashga majbur bo'ldi.

examples.title: Nations: **the French**, **the Dutch**, **the Swiss**
examples.description: -sh, -ch, -ss, -ese bilan tugaydigan millat nomlari: the + sifat, `-s` siz, ko'plik fe'li bilan: the British, the French, the Dutch, the Swiss, the Chinese, the Japanese.

sentences.text: **The French** are famous for their bread and cheese.
sentences.translation: **Fransuzlar** noni va pishlog'i bilan mashhur.

sentences.text: **The British** drink more tea than almost any other nation.
sentences.translation: **Britaniyaliklar** deyarli boshqa har qanday xalqdan ko'proq choy ichadi.

sentences.text: Everyone in the Netherlands seems to cycle — **the Dutch** even ride bikes in the rain.
sentences.translation: Niderlandiyada hamma velosipedda yuradiganga o'xshaydi — **gollandlar** hatto yomg'irda ham velosiped minishadi.

sentences.text: Switzerland has four official languages, so **the Swiss** often speak at least two.
sentences.translation: Shveytsariyada to'rtta rasmiy til bor, shuning uchun **shveytsariyaliklar** ko'pincha kamida ikki tilda gaplashadi.

sentences.text: Did you know that **the Japanese** live longer than almost anyone else?
sentences.translation: **Yaponlar** deyarli hammadan uzoqroq umr ko'rishini bilarmidingiz?

sentences.text: Paper, gunpowder and the compass were all invented by **the Chinese**.
sentences.translation: Qog'oz, porox va kompas — bularning hammasini **xitoyliklar** ixtiro qilgan.

sentences.text: **The Spanish** usually have dinner very late, often after ten.
sentences.translation: **Ispanlar** odatda kechki ovqatni juda kech, ko'pincha soat o'ndan keyin yeyishadi.

sentences.text: Our guide said that **the Irish** are the friendliest people in Europe.
sentences.translation: Gidimizning aytishicha, **irlandlar** Yevropadagi eng samimiy xalq.

sentences.text: Kate is **English**, not Scottish, although she lives in Edinburgh.
sentences.translation: Keyt Edinburgda yashasa ham, **ingliz**, shotlandiyalik emas.

sentences.text: Every spring, **the English** and **the Welsh** play rugby against each other, and the whole country watches.
sentences.translation: Har bahorda **inglizlar** va **uelsliklar** bir-biriga qarshi regbi o'ynashadi, butun mamlakat tomosha qiladi.

examples.title: **Uzbeks**, **a German**, **a Frenchman**
examples.description: Boshqa millatlar `-s` bilan ko'plikda: (the) Uzbeks, Germans, Kazakhs; bitta odam — an Uzbek, a German. -sh / -ch guruhida bitta odam — a Frenchman, a Dutch woman. Til nomi — artiklsiz.

sentences.text: **Uzbeks** are known for their hospitality, especially towards guests from abroad.
sentences.translation: **O'zbeklar** mehmondo'stligi bilan, ayniqsa chet ellik mehmonlarga nisbatan, mashhur.

sentences.text: **The Germans** produce some of the best cars in the world.
sentences.translation: **Nemislar** dunyodagi eng yaxshi mashinalarning bir qismini ishlab chiqaradi.

sentences.text: Our new neighbour is **a Kazakh** from Almaty who teaches maths.
sentences.translation: Yangi qo'shnimiz — matematikadan dars beradigan olmaotalik **qozoq**.

sentences.text: My best friend at university was **a Frenchman** called Pierre.
sentences.translation: Universitetdagi eng yaqin do'stim Pyer ismli **fransuz** edi.

sentences.text: Is your colleague **a Turk**? — No, he's **an Azerbaijani**, but he speaks Turkish.
sentences.translation: Hamkasbingiz **turkmi**? — Yo'q, u **ozarbayjon**, lekin turkcha gapiradi.

sentences.text: **English** is difficult to spell, but **the English** themselves often make spelling mistakes.
sentences.translation: **Ingliz tili** imlosi qiyin, lekin **inglizlarning** o'zlari ham ko'pincha imlo xatosi qilishadi.

sentences.text: There were two **Americans**, **a Pole** and **a Dutch woman** in our tour group.
sentences.translation: Sayohat guruhimizda ikkita **amerikalik**, bitta **polyak** va bitta **golland ayol** bor edi.

sentences.text: **Koreans** have lived in Uzbekistan since the 1930s.
sentences.translation: **Koreyslar** O'zbekistonda 1930-yillardan beri yashaydi.

sentences.text: Emma married **a Scot**, and now she's learning to cook haggis.
sentences.translation: Emma **shotlandiyalikka** turmushga chiqdi, endi xaggis pishirishni o'rganyapti.

sentences.text: Although **an Uzbek** may find London expensive, **the British** find Tashkent surprisingly cheap.
sentences.translation: **O'zbek** odamiga London qimmat tuyulishi mumkin, **britaniyaliklarga** esa Toshkent hayratlanarli darajada arzon tuyuladi.

examples.title: Mixed: species, groups and nations
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: the + birlik ot (tur, ixtiro), the + sifat (odamlar guruhi), the + millat va umumiy ko'plik — murakkabroq gaplarda.

sentences.text: **The camera** was invented in the nineteenth century, but now everyone carries one in their pocket.
sentences.translation: **Fotoapparat** o'n to'qqizinchi asrda ixtiro qilingan, hozir esa hamma uni cho'ntagida olib yuradi.

sentences.text: Our city needs more parks for **the young** and more benches for **the elderly**.
sentences.translation: Shahrimizga **yoshlar** uchun ko'proq bog'lar, **keksalar** uchun esa ko'proq o'rindiqlar kerak.

sentences.text: **The Japanese** eat a lot of fish, which may explain why they live so long.
sentences.translation: **Yaponlar** ko'p baliq yeydi, balki shuning uchun ular uzoq yashashar.

sentences.text: I'm not keen on **snakes**, but I know that **the cobra** rarely attacks people.
sentences.translation: **Ilonlarni** yoqtirmayman, lekin **kobra** odamlarga kamdan-kam hujum qilishini bilaman.

sentences.text: Doctors say **the human body** can survive weeks without food but only days without water.
sentences.translation: Shifokorlarning aytishicha, **inson tanasi** ovqatsiz haftalab, suvsiz esa bor-yo'g'i bir necha kun yashay oladi.

sentences.text: Is it fair that **the rich** can buy better healthcare than **the poor**?
sentences.translation: **Boylar** **kambag'allarga** qaraganda yaxshiroq tibbiy xizmat sotib ola olishi adolatdanmi?

sentences.text: Madina is **an Uzbek** who grew up in Moscow, so she speaks Russian like a native.
sentences.translation: Madina Moskvada o'sgan **o'zbek**, shuning uchun ruschani ona tilidek biladi.

sentences.text: **The euro** replaced **the French franc** in 2002.
sentences.translation: 2002 yilda **yevro** **fransuz frankining** o'rnini egalladi.

sentences.text: Charities in Tashkent collect warm clothes for **the homeless** every December.
sentences.translation: Toshkentdagi xayriya tashkilotlari har dekabrda **uysizlar** uchun issiq kiyim to'playdi.

sentences.text: Thanks to the internet, **the Dutch** and **the Uzbeks** can now play chess against each other without leaving home.
sentences.translation: Internet tufayli endi **gollandlar** va **o'zbeklar** uydan chiqmasdan bir-biri bilan shaxmat o'ynashi mumkin.
